dogecoin.text: @sbarawkar @dogecoin @cb_doge Hello. Sometimes technical maintenance requires additional effort and time. In this case, we need a while longer to complete the work on the DOGE wallet. While withdrawals are closed during maintenance, trading functionality is available at that moment.

@sbarawkar @dogecoin @cb_doge Hello. The fee is applied as per our Terms of use (clause 18.4). To keep your account active, you can initiate any type of transaction with any coin available on the platform, not necessarily DOGE withdrawals. You can make a deposit or trade assets.
